description:
Get Vibe Shipped sponsorship offers (featured listing, week sponsor, Weekly Top 10 presenting sponsor, month takeover) with prices, what each includes, and Stripe checkout links.

Use when: the user asks about advertising or sponsoring on Vibe Shipped. Hand the human the checkout URL; the agent does not pay. Sponsored placements are labeled and rankings are not for sale.

Behavior: Read-only, no parameters. Returns offers, a checkout object for the $300 Week Sponsor (one-click Stripe payment link), the contact email and the sponsor page URL.

Example: {}
name: get_sponsorship_info
title: Sponsorship offers, prices and checkout links
